# Karabel Doğal Taş (Karabel Natural Stone)

> Karabel Natural Stone is a marble and travertine manufacturer founded in 2014 in the Denizli Organised Industrial Zone (Honaz, Türkiye). It produces travertine and marble mosaics, tiles, Versailles (mini set) patterns, hexagons and split-face wall panels, cuts to size, and sells in Türkiye and abroad.

> Karabel Doğal Taş, 2014'te Denizli Organize Sanayi Bölgesi'nde (Honaz) kurulmuş bir mermer ve traverten üreticisidir. Traverten ve mermerden mozaik, tek parça karo, Versailles (mini set), altıgen ve patlatma duvar paneli üretir; ölçüye özel kesim yapar ve yurt içine ve yurt dışına satış yapar.

- Address: Organize Sanayi Bölgesi 1. Kısım, Fahri Karaca Cad. No:18, Honaz, Denizli, Türkiye
- Phone / WhatsApp: +90 555 983 78 78
- Email: info@karabeldogaltas.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/karabeldogaltas/
- Product photos are real samples; sizes are measured from the photos (about ±5%).

## Stones / Taşlar

- [Beige Marble](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/beige-marble/): A cream-beige marble in light and dark selections that makes a calm, even surface.
- [Blue Stone Marble](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/blue-stone-marble/): A cool, modern marble where blue-grey and slate tones cross light veins.
- [Muğla White Marble](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/mugla-white-marble/): A classic white marble known for smoky grey clouds and fine veins over a white ground.
- [Pink Marble](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/pink-marble/): An elegant pink marble with white veins over a dusty-rose ground.
- [Toros Black Marble](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/toros-black-marble/): A marble that sets sharp white veins against a dark anthracite-black ground for strong contrast.
- [Veined Noce Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/veined-noce-travertine/): A rhythmic travertine animated by distinct parallel bands of warm brown and walnut.
- [Classic Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/classic-travertine/): A simple stone reflecting the warm beige-cream tone and natural porous structure of classic Denizli travertine.
- [Light Mix Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/light-mix-travertine/): A bright travertine where light cream and ivory tones blend softly — easy to pair with any architectural style.
- [Mix Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/mix-travertine/): A lively travertine whose natural colour drifts from light cream to warm beige and soft caramel.
- [Noce Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/noce-travertine/): Walnut and warm earth-brown tones that give a room a grounded, warm Mediterranean feel.
- [Pink Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/pink-travertine/): A travertine in salmon and earthy pink that creates an unusual, soft atmosphere.
- [Yellow Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/yellow-travertine/): A golden, honey-toned travertine that brings warmth to terraces, gardens and outdoor spaces.
- [Silver Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/silver-travertine/): A grey travertine where silver, ash and warm stone tones intertwine — at home in modern and industrial spaces.
- [Walnut Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/walnut-travertine/): A warm travertine balanced between milky coffee and walnut shell, with soft transitions.
- [Emperador Marble](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/emperador-marble/): A marble with fine, light network veins over a brown ground — classic and rich.
- [Eymer Black Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/eymer-black-travertine/): A high-contrast stone combining dark grey and anthracite with travertine's porous texture.
- [Ivory Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/ivory-travertine/): Off-white and light ivory — the brightest, most understated travertine in the collection.
- [Light Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/light-travertine/): A calm travertine selection showing its porous texture in the brightest cream and light beige tones.
- [Light + Noce Mix Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/light-noce-mix-travertine/): A two-tone blend pairing light cream Light and warm brown Noce travertine on one sheet.
- [Nebula Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/nebula-travertine/): A calm travertine with cloud-like soft tonal shifts over a cream-grey ground.
- [Onix Silver Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/onix-silver-travertine/): A characterful grey travertine with layered, deep veining over a silver-grey ground.
- [Sarı + Noce + Light Mix Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/sari-noce-light-mix-travertine/): A three-tone blend of cream, gold and walnut travertine with a rich colour rhythm.
- [Sarı + Noce Mix Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/sari-noce-mix-travertine/): A two-tone blend of golden and walnut travertine in warm earth tones.
- [Scabas Travertine](https://anbertech.github.io/Test/karabel/en/stone/scabas-travertine/): A travertine where cream, honey and brown meet in strong patterns — distinctly rustic.
